name: Womens Rights
overview: Scripture reveals that women held significant and honored roles within God's plan, as seen in Deborah's leadership as a prophetess and judge over Israel (Judges 4:4) and the active participation of women in ministry alongside Jesus (Matthew 27:55). The outpouring of the Spirit upon both servants and handmaids (Joel 2:29) affirms God's empowerment of women for service and witness. Furthermore, Jesus' first appearance to Mary Magdalene after His resurrection (Mark 16:9) highlights the value He placed on women as witnesses to the gospel.
